description: A version range the adapter can satisfy: it negotiates 1, declares its manifest, and answers a health probe against a recorded catalog whose last scan finished eight hours before the response was generated. recall/refresh follows and returns the same health, unchanged: this source is live and owns no projection, so there is nothing to bring up to date, and reporting work it did not do would let a caller believe a stale catalog had been rescanned.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
